An '''analysis sensor'''<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref> or '''analytical sensor'''<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] installed on [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The [[RM-2020 espionage droid]] had analysis sensors installed,<ref name="CFTD" /> as did the [[Decon III]].<ref name="EGTD" />
